title: 第2123章 不欢而散第2122章 太一真水
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙，谁能比我极阴更阴！第二卷：玄界第2123章不欢而散（..la）“在下倒是对穆俪道友的太一真水感兴趣。不知穆俪道友作价多少？”宋文问道。
穆俪眼眸微微一挑，一双杏眼妩媚的瞟向宋文。
“只需两万仙元石，这瓶太一真水，就归道友了。”
“看来此物与在下无缘了。就是将在下的本命法宝卖了，只怕也凑不齐这两万仙元石。”宋文叹息道。
“呵呵！”穆俪轻笑出声，“道友别妄自菲薄嘛。仙元石不足，可以用其他宝物来凑。道友可将身上的宝物都拿出来，或许其中便有妾身所急需之物。”
宋文迟疑片刻，随后便取出了数件灵物，但都是仙品之下的九阶灵物，皆是他杀人掠货所得。
这些东西，自然入不了穆俪等人的眼。
几人看过后，全都露出了不以为然的神色。
穆俪更是微微摇头，眼波流转间带着几分似笑非笑的揶揄。
“道友莫不是在说笑？这些九阶灵物，放在外面或许还算稀罕。但在今日这凉亭之中，怕是连添头都算不上。”
“道友若是诚心想要这太一真水，不妨再翻翻家底。妾身可不信，一位能修炼到灵虚道仙境界的道友，身上就只有这些不入流的小玩意儿。”
宋文道，“在下实在拿不出其他宝物。不过，在下凑一凑，尚能拿出六千仙元石，不知穆俪可否分割太一真水，在下只买其中三成。”
此言一出，穆俪还未接话，反而邬良率先开了口。
“勾钧道友，你这就有些不符规矩了。众所周知，真水这一类的宝物，数量越多，价值便越高。拆分成零碎，用处便大大折扣，价值也骤降。”
“既如此，是在下强人所难了。还望穆俪道友海涵。”
宋文说完，便不再开口，显然是不打算要那太一真水了。
“勾钧道友，别急啊。”穆俪娇媚出声，“妾身这太一真水，并非不能拆分。不过，邬良所言，也不无道理。三成的太一真水，不能仅作价六千仙元石，妾身要一万仙元石。”
宋文道，“道友的好意，在下心领。但我实在拿不出万枚仙元石。”
穆俪道，“道友可用其他宝物抵数。极品灵宝，稀有灵草丹药，功法秘术...均可。”
宋文嘴角微微抽了几下。

听穆俪这话外之音，简直是想掏空自己身上的宝物。
宋文眼眸一转，又看向邬良、纪桐等人。
这六人，全都目不转睛的看着他。
宋文顿觉，这六人，只怕是一伙的。
而今日这交流会，也是针对他一人，只为从他身上捞取好处。
“不必了。”宋文道，“太一真水，对于在下而言，虽然重要，但也并非不可或缺之物。”
见宋文拒绝得如此干脆，穆俪红唇几次微动，但终究未再多说什么。
而其他人，也并未接话；整个凉亭之中，顿时有些沉默。
“咳——”
邬良装模作样的轻咳一声，打破了沉默。

Volume 2: Xuanjie Chapter 2123: Parting on bad terms (..la) "I am actually interested in Taoist Taoist Mu Li's Taiyi True Water. I wonder how much Taoist Taoist Mu Li paid for it?" Song Wen asked.
Mu Li raised her eyes slightly, and glanced at Song Wen with a pair of charming almond eyes.
"With only 20,000 Immortal Essence Stones, this bottle of Taiyi True Water will belong to fellow Taoist."
"It seems that this thing is no longer destined for me. Even if I sell my natal magic weapon, I'm afraid I won't be able to collect the 20,000 immortal yuan stones." Song Wen sighed.
"Haha!" Mu Li chuckled, "Fellow Taoist, don't underestimate yourself. If you don't have enough Immortal Essence Stones, you can use other treasures to make up for it. You can take out all the treasures you have on your body. Maybe there is something I need urgently among them."
Song Wen hesitated for a moment, and then took out several spiritual objects, but they were all ninth-level spiritual objects below the immortal grade. They were all obtained by killing people and looting goods.
These things naturally cannot enter the eyes of Mu Li and others.
After several people saw it, they all showed disapproval.
Mu Li shook her head slightly, her eyes moving with a hint of teasing that seemed to be a smile but not a smile.
"Are you kidding, fellow Taoist? These ninth-level spiritual objects may be considered rare outside. But in this pavilion today, I'm afraid they are not even considered rare."
"If fellow Taoist sincerely want this Taiyi True Water, you might as well dig into your family's fortune. I don't believe it. A fellow Taoist who can cultivate to the realm of Lingxu Dao Immortal only has these low-grade gadgets on his body."
Song Wendao said, "I really can't come up with any other treasures. However, if I scrape them together, I can still come up with six thousand Immortal Essence Stones. I wonder if Mu Li can split the Taiyi True Water, and I will only buy 30% of it."
As soon as these words came out, Mu Li didn't answer, but Wu Liang spoke first.
"Fellow Daoist Gou Jun, you are not following the rules. As we all know, the greater the quantity of treasures such as true water, the higher their value. If they are broken into pieces, their usefulness will be greatly reduced and their value will also drop sharply."
"In this case, it is difficult for me to force others. I also hope that my Taoist friend Mu Li, Haihan, will do it."
After Song Wen finished speaking, he stopped talking, obviously not planning to ask for the Taiyi True Water.
"Fellow Taoist Gou Jun, don't be anxious." Mu Li said coquettishly, "The Taiyi True Water in my body is not inseparable. However, what Wu Liang said is not unreasonable. 30% of the Taiyi True Water cannot be priced at only 6,000 Immortal Essence Stones, and I need 10,000 Immortal Essence Stones."
Song Wendao said, "I appreciate the kindness of my fellow Taoist. But I really can't produce ten thousand Immortal Essence Stones."
Mu Li said, "Fellow Taoist can use other treasures to offset the amount. Top-grade spiritual treasures, rare spiritual herbs, pills, secret techniques... can be used."
Song Wen's mouth twitched slightly.
Hearing Mu Li's words, she just wanted to empty out all the treasures she had on her body.
Song Wen turned his eyes and looked at Wu Liang, Ji Tong and others.
These six people all looked at him intently.
Song Wen suddenly felt that these six people were probably in the same group.
And today's exchange meeting was also aimed at him alone, just to gain benefits from him.
"No need." Song Wendao said, "Taiyi True Water is important to me, but it is not indispensable."
Seeing Song Wen's refusal so simply, Mu Li's red lips moved slightly a few times, but in the end she didn't say anything more.
Others did not answer the conversation; there was a sudden silence in the entire pavilion.
"Ahem——"
Wu Liang gave a pretentious cough and broke the silence.
